title: What you'll be able to do
notes: The course preview, shown while enrolling, before the quick check. About a minute. It builds trust and interest by showing the learner the end of the course: the agent they will have built, working; that it is steps they can learn; what they will be able to do; what it takes; and what they will walk away with. It does not tour the modules or explain how the course works.
